params.body:
In the writing view the headline was a one-line input, so a long title ran off to the right instead of wrapping, for example "Proof Over Polish: Fans Believe Creators Who Show Their Work".

## Change

- The headline is a textarea that grows with its text, and again when the column changes width (dragging the seam beside the conversation).
- Enter moves to the standfirst instead of adding a line; a line break in a pasted title becomes a space, since a title has none.
- Same type, size and colour as before.

## Checks

- `npm test` 47/47, `vite build` clean.
- In a local Studio, that title wraps over two lines and the field is as tall as its text (72px, scroll height 72px).
params.title: Write: the headline wraps
